items.q: What systems do you integrate with?
items.a: Your phone system, your CRM, and your scheduling or management software. That includes dealer management systems, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Dentrix, Open Dental, Tekmetric, Mindbody, and most others. If a system has no way to connect, we tell you in the audit.

items.a: Customer data is stored and processed in the United States. For dental and orthodontic groups we work within HIPAA requirements and sign a business associate agreement.

items.q: How long does an audit take?
items.a: Two weeks from kickoff to your report. We need a few hours of your team's time across those two weeks, mostly listening to how things work today.

items.q: What if you find nothing worth automating?
items.a: We tell you, and you keep the report. It is a $5,000 look at your operation with numbers attached. Nobody is obligated to build anything.
